usedFor: Teams use WhatsAndro to message contacts with “Send WhatsApp Message” and “Send Template Message”, through your WhatsAndro account.

bestTemplate.name: “Send Template Message” in WhatsAndro
bestTemplate.why: It sends a template message to a contact, through your WhatsAndro account.

watchOut: Messages to contacts outside your business wait for your approval before “Send WhatsApp Message” runs.
